blocks.text: Remember Hannah, Church? She prayed so hard for a son that the priest thought she was drunk. God gave her that boy, and she named him Samuel. When he was weaned, she brought him to the house of the LORD to grow up serving the old priest Eli.

verses.text: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Thank God for the old saints who know the sound of God's voice and teach the young ones how to listen. Eli could not hear it himself that night. But he knew what it was, and he pointed that child in the right direction.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Samuel grew up to be a prophet over all Israel. It started with a boy lying in the dark, saying, speak, for I am listening. God still speaks to children. And he still uses the old folks to help them know it is him.

first_reader.note: Written by Claude in the landing session, then Claude's pastor and cultural read.

pastor.note: Faithful to 1 Sam 3:1-10; Hannah from 1 Sam 1; God's call read as scripture; Eli's instruction voiced by Eli; v1 put in narration in our own words (no typed verse).

cultural.note: The old saints teaching the young to hear God, without any invented person; 'speak, Lord' at the turn.
